item.title: Her Children Ask, ‘Mommy, Where Are You?’
item.description: Mrs. Liba Schtroks, a devoted shlucha and beloved mother, leaves behind eleven children, most of whom are not yet married, after fighting a terrible illness for 14 years. It is our responsibility to help her grieving family. Full Story

item.title: Parshah Almanac for Beshalach
item.description: Can we protect the Jewish people with hand gestures? Which parts of Torah did we get before Matan Torah? These questions and more are explored in this week’s Parshah Almanac. Full Story

item.title: 770 Ramming Attacker Faces Hate Crime Charges
item.description: Police charged alleged 770 car ramming suspect Dan Sohail, 36, from Carteret, N.J. with attempted assault, criminal mischief and aggravated harassment — all as hate crimes. Full Story

item.title: As Camp Registration Reaches 250, CKids Launches ‘One for 75’
